sections.title: Assessment session
sections.markdown: Start interview_007 in the Interview Center. This 60-minute session reserves 45 minutes for the concept-check assessment and 15 for feedback. The candidate brief appears at start; reference solutions require the debrief stage. Record actual queries, histories, or diagrams rather than awarding proficiency for viewing the rubric.

exercise.prompt: Start the mapped assessment and save the actual reasoning and evidence.
rubric: Use the supplied weighted rubric with concrete attempt excerpts.
exercise.solution: Reference reasoning is stored separately in the gated interview debrief.

mentalModel: Correctness is a history you can defend, not a database feature name.
